notes.title: Torn Earth has been released!
notes.content:
Hey guys Torn Earth has now been released on steam thanks to everyone who has supported the game and our other games. 

Torn Earth is our newest adventure and the current build is episode 1, other episodes will follow within the next few weeks. There will be no paid dlc or addons all episodes and extras will be included in upcoming updates.

As always any and all feedback is welcome and please report any bugs or issues you encounter during your playthrough.

Thanks everyone and enjoy the game!
